team.description: Linear team id or key (required to create issues).

project.description: Default Linear project id, or null.

cycle.description: Default Linear cycle id, or null.

status_map.description: Plugin action-item status -> Linear workflow state name.

assignee_map.description: Plugin owner string -> Linear user id/email/name (or 'me').

enforcement.description: How strongly to enforce that tasks are tracked in Linear.

label.description: Optional Linear label applied to synced issues.
